plan.purpose: Independent longer-window recheck of R97 lookup_c4 p99 +14.43%, lookup_all_64 p99 +3.57% and invoke CPU/tails; selected after pilot, no pooling or replacement
plan.safety: Guarded private mount/PID/net namespace, before/after stock health and owned-directory cleanup per run
plan.memory: End-of-window proc counts are diagnostic, not precise memory acceptance. Independently measure retained and construction-peak requested Rust heap with actual ADD_OBJECT dispatch on both versions.
plan.failure_rule: Stop on collection, correctness, identity, health or cleanup failure; retain raw failed window
plan.analysis: Eight exploratory randomized paired blocks, longer windows; report all per-block signs and ranges. No equivalence or superiority claim. Keep the first four-arm matrix and every adverse result.
plan.hypothesis: Determine whether adverse tails and invoke own CPU repeat in longer independent windows with unchanged runtime/client artifacts.
plan.retention_rule: Reject correctness failures. If any selected lane p99 paired median exceeds +5% with at least six of eight positive pairs, defer runtime retention for more diagnosis. Otherwise assess along with all CPU, tail and memory results; lack of recurrence is not proof of no regression.
plan.build_control: Same actual /tmp/owrt-core-release/ubusd source root, SDK, toolchain, cwd and release flags as before; previous exact-root reconstruction reproduced before bytes.
plan.client_control: Frozen ca1a912 client and dependencies plus only process CPU clocks; same binary on all four arms. Do not pool R95/R96 measurements.

method: Paired exploratory blocks; full per-run values; no confidence or equivalence claim
scope: ubusd only, private router namespace, 4 lanes; object counts (64,)
